verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official OpenAPI specification repository for its API (which Terminal is built on) at github.com/stripe/openapi, machine-readable and maintained, though direct probe attempts at docs.stripe.com/openapi.json returned 404s, indicating it's hosted separately rather than at a predictable docs endpoint. Missing for 10: a direct discoverable link from Terminal-specific docs to the spec, and confirmation the spec covers Terminal endpoints specifically.
